messages:
Sam W.: Quick follow-ups from today's all-hands — couple quick Qs about partner-led deals and pipeline handoffs.
Aisha G.: Good q — can leadership clarify partner-sourced lead ownership? In the all-hands slide it sounded like CS takes first contact but deals transfer to AEs. Example: Acme pilot — who owns next steps?
Marcos R.: For now partner-sourced leads go to the Channel AE queue. SLA: Channel AE should claim within 2 hours; if unclaimed, it goes to pooled rotation. I'll update the playbook and post a PR.
Jia L.: Short answer: partner-sourced -> Channel AE for qualification -> if not assigned in 24h escalates to SDR rotation. We're planning to tighten to 12h SLA for Q3.
Ben P.: On demos: partners can run sandbox demos for discovery. For product demos aimed at procurement, AE must be present. Scheduling SLA is 3 business days currently.
Elena V.: Confirming the handoff stage is 'Partner Handoff' in Salesforce. Important: tag partner_id in the record and set 'lead_source=partner'. I'll push the SFDC validation rule today.
Sam W.: Thanks — also can Marketing provide a co-branded 1-pager and intro email template for partners to use?
Amanda S.: Yes — Marketing will produce a co-branded 1-pager + 2 email templates. ETA: Friday EOD. @Sam W. please add partner bullets to this sheet: https://redwood.company/docs/partner-assets
deploy-bot: Notes uploaded to All Hands folder: https://redwood.company/notes/allhands-2026-03-23 (pdf)
Sam W.: One more ask — are Dedicated customers prioritized in routing? I heard yes but want written confirmation so PLs can set expectations.
Jia L.: Prioritization: yes for deals with ARR > $250k, or with compliance/Government tags. We'll publish a short prioritization rubric tomorrow morning.
Marcos R.: I'll draft the rubric and link it into the playbook and #sales-ops.
Sam W.: :thumbsup: I'll track the action items in Asana and follow up. Thanks everyone!
